craft.description: Compatibility shortcut for Impeccable new visual work.

init.description: Capture missing product context in PRODUCT.md when setup is requested.

document.description: Document the implemented visual system in DESIGN.md.

extract.description: Consolidate repeated UI patterns into reusable components and tokens.

live.description: Explore design variants interactively in a running local interface.

adapt.description: Adapt an existing interface to requested screen sizes or platforms.

animate.description: Add purposeful motion to a specified interface or interaction.

audit.description: Audit frontend accessibility, performance and responsive behavior.

bolder.description: Increase visual emphasis when the user requests a bolder interface.

clarify.description: Improve interface labels, instructions and error-message clarity.

colorize.description: Refine an interface palette when the user requests more color.

critique.description: Evaluate frontend design and explain actionable UX findings.

delight.description: Add requested moments of personality to an existing interface.

distill.description: Simplify an interface by removing unnecessary visual complexity.

harden.description: Improve interface error handling, overflow and real-data resilience.

onboard.description: Design first-run experiences, onboarding flows and empty states.

layout.description: Improve spacing, alignment and composition in a specified interface.

optimize.description: Diagnose and fix frontend loading or rendering performance problems.

overdrive.description: Implement ambitious visual effects when explicitly requested.

polish.description: Fix alignment, spacing and visual inconsistencies in an existing interface.

quieter.description: Reduce visual intensity when a calmer interface is requested.

shape.description: Plan UX and deliver a design brief without implementation.

typeset.description: Improve interface typography, hierarchy and readability.
